channel.title: SandboxSim
channel.description: SandboxSim updates, read by Sparkle in the app. tools/publish-release.sh in the app's repository adds the items.

item.description:
SandboxSim 0.20

  • 关闭了网络的虚拟机现在可以正常启动，不再一直停在“正在启动”。虚拟机里仍然没有网络。
  • 已知问题：关闭网络时，虚拟机里的时钟可能比实际时间慢，因为没有网络可以对时。

SandboxSim 0.20 (English)

  • A virtual machine with its network turned off now starts normally instead of staying at "starting" forever. It still has no network.
  • Known issue: with the network off, the clock in the virtual machine can be behind the real time, since there is no network to set it from.

SandboxSim 0.19

  • 许可证和试用期的检查更可靠。
  • 新建虚拟机的窗口里会说明：虚拟机里不能登录 Apple 账户，iCloud 和 App Store 都用不了。

SandboxSim 0.19 (English)

  • Licence and trial checks are more reliable.
  • The new machine window now says that you can't sign in to an Apple Account in a machine, so iCloud and the App Store don't work.
